Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the candid conversation about your latency and cost pain around inference on real-time payments workloads. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Problem: 200ms P95 latency target during peak trading windows; costs from overprovisioned GPUs and ad-hoc cache misses.
- What we showed: preliminary throughput projections on an m60-type footprint, prefix cache approach to reduce repeat-token cost, and our routing/fallback idea for regional failover.

1) Tech deep-dive with your platform engineering (30–45m) — dig into model sizes, sequence lengths, and expected QPS distribution.
2) Share baseline logs/metrics (anonymized) so we can run a quick cost model.
3) Draft MA/POC plan and timing.
